result.nextStep: Pass a result's preflightArgs ({chain, address}) to pacta_check_preflight (or pacta_scan_control_plane) for a live check.
result.note: easAttested protocols are Base-EAS-anchored records that compare on-chain state with the protocol's documentation. rpc_observed protocols pin the on-chain control plane over archive JSON-RPC and do not assess the documentation (documentationComparison: not_assessed). Briefs are block-pinned verification briefs. preflightArgs re-read the contract live.
result.hint: No match. Call again with an empty query to list what Pacta tracks, or pass a known 0x contract address straight to pacta_check_preflight.
result.coverage_gap_hint: Target is not yet indexed or fully classified. Ask the user if they want you to queue coverage or request this capability via pacta_submit_request (free community queue, or 24h priority clearance for issuers).

upgrade_x402.note: Free tier: 50 pre-flight calls per caller per UTC day (REST and MCP), then $0.01 per call over x402 (HTTP 402, never a dead-end 429). Paid routes below: POST the JSON body with an x402 X-PAYMENT (v1) or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (v2) header.

endpoints.unlocks: fast contract / token control-plane verdict: riskScore 0-100, grade A-F, upgrade / owner / pause / blacklist / mint flags and a shareable scan URL
full control-plane dossier: every controller Safe's signers and threshold, signers shared with other indexed protocols, Base EAS proof
pre-signing calldata check: timelock / Safe / multicall calls decoded, each rated against live delays and the authority that governs it
deep control-plane scan cross-checked on two independent RPC operators, auditor receipt and a queued Base EAS ticket
